display_name: Sam Synthetic — fatigue and mixed evidence

entries.text: Fictional teaching case: Type 2 diabetes recorded in a fictional follow-up note.
Fictional teaching case: metformin 500 mg orally once daily documented; current use requires reconciliation.
Fictional teaching case: Hemoglobin 10.8 g/dL and ferritin 12 micrograms/L reported; reference ranges and repeat results not supplied.
Fictional teaching case: Patient reports fatigue, short sleep during night shifts and irregular meals. No cause established.
Fictional teaching case: Patient reports fatigue persisted during a week away from shifts; duration and sleep hours were not recorded.
Fictional teaching case: Patient reports an over-the-counter supplement, with unknown name, dose and start date.
Fictional teaching case: Allergy history, current blood pressure and current warning-sign screening were not supplied.
